description.zh: 系统版本黑名单列表，英文逗号隔开。
description.en: The blacklist of operating system versions, separated by commas (,).

description.zh: 是否允许移动网络下载升级包
description.en: Specifies whether to allow downloading upgrade packages over a mobile network.

description.zh: 是否强制夜间升级，Y或N；与强制升级不能同时选择是。
description.en: Specifies whether to force a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N. This parameter and IsForceUpgrade cannot both be set to Y.
Specifies whether to force an upgrade. Valid values: Y and N.
Specifies whether the version is a milestone. Valid values: Y and N.

description.zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最大版本versioncode
description.en: The maximum version code of the allowed OTA SDK version.

description.zh: 允许的OTA SDK的最小版本versioncode
description.en: The minimum version code of the allowed OTA SDK version.

description.zh: 允许移动网络下载的包的最大限制，单位为M，在允许移动网络下载包的情况下，大于该限制的包也不会自动下载。
description.en: The maximum size of packages that can be downloaded over a mobile network, in MB. When mobile network download is enabled, packages larger than this limit are not automatically downloaded.

description.zh: 夜间升级下载类型，1表示WIFI下下载，2表示任全网下载。
description.en:
The download type for night upgrades. Valid values:
- 1: download over Wi-Fi only
- 2: download over any network.

description.zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，Y或N。
description.en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N.

description.zh: 夜间升级时是否给出提示框，Y或N。
description.en: Specifies whether to display a prompt dialog box during a night upgrade. Valid values: Y and N.

description.zh: 版本发布说明，客户端展示升级说明。
description.en: The release notes for the version. This information is displayed to users on the client as upgrade instructions.

description.zh: 版本备注，仅用于服务端管理维护。
description.en: The remarks for the version. This information is used only for server-side management and maintenance.

description.zh:
升级包列表，包括全量包和增量包。

格式为：`id|baseVersion|romUrl,id|baseVersion|romUrl`。

- 第一位指升级包的ID，如果是新的升级包，则为0。
- 第二位为基准系统版本号，全量包的基准系统版本号位0。
- 最后一位为升级包下载地址。
description.en:
The list of upgrade packages, including full and incremental packages.

Format: `id|baseVersion|romUrl,id|baseVersion|romUrl`.

- The first field is the ID of the upgrade package. Set this field to 0 for a new upgrade package.
- The second field is the base operating system version number. The base version number for a full package is 0.
- The last field is the download URL of the upgrade package.

description.zh: 系统版本白名单列表，英文逗号隔开。
description.en: The whitelist of operating system versions, separated by commas (,).

title.zh: 更新系统版本的基本信息
title.en: Update basic information of an operating system version

descriptions.zh: 用户创建完系统版本后，可能需要修改系统版本，可以调用此接口进行修改。
descriptions.en: After you create an operating system version, you can call this operation to modify its basic information.
